description: Defines the QuicServer class, a toy QUIC server implementation for testing correctness, including server setup, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: QuicServer
classes.description: A lightweight QUIC server class for testing client correctness, handling connections, and managing server configurations.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified UDP address.

methods.name: HandleEventsForever
methods.description: Processes all incoming events indefinitely.

methods.name: WaitForEvents
methods.description: Waits up to 50ms for events and processes them.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Prepares the server for shutdown and cleans up sessions.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events, as part of QuicSocketEventListener.

methods.name: SetChloMultiplier
methods.description: Sets the CHLO multiplier in crypto config.

methods.name: SetPreSharedKey
methods.description: Sets the pre-shared key for crypto configuration.

methods.name: overflow_supported
methods.description: Returns whether socket overflow is supported.

methods.name: packets_dropped
methods.description: Returns the number of dropped packets.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the server's listening port.

methods.name: event_loop
methods.description: Returns the event loop instance.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Creates a QuicPacketWriter for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a QuicDispatcher instance.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new QuicEventLoop instance.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns the server's QuicConfig.

methods.name: crypto_config
methods.description: Returns the server's QuicCryptoServerConfig.

methods.name: dispatcher
methods.description: Returns the QuicDispatcher instance.

methods.name: version_manager
methods.description: Returns the QuicVersionManager instance.

methods.name: server_backend
methods.description: Returns the backend associated with the server.

methods.name: set_silent_close
methods.description: Sets whether to silently close connections.

methods.name: expected_server_connection_id_length
methods.description: Returns the expected connection ID length.

methods.name: connection_id_generator
methods.description: Returns the connection ID generator.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes internal server state.
